name: DDX41-related Hematologic Malignancy Predisposition Syndrome
aliases: DDX41 hereditary predisposition to myeloid malignancies

ethnicAssociations: Reported in multiple ethnicities including European, Asian, and African descent

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed criteria for DDX41-related hematologic malignancy predisposition

criteria.description: Presence of a pathogenic or likely pathogenic germline DDX41 variant
Diagnosis of a myeloid malignancy such as myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
Family history of hematologic malignancies consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Presence of a somatic DDX41 mutation in hematologic malignancy cells

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a pathogenic germline DDX41 variant plus diagnosis of a myeloid malignancy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for confirmation; family history supports but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic bone marrow dysplasia in affected individuals
searchTerms: low blood cell counts resistant to treatment with abnormal cells
refractory cytopenias with dysplastic blood cells
persistent low blood counts with cell abnormalities
blood disorder with abnormal marrow cells

common.symptomName: Anemia with normocytic or macrocytic indices
searchTerms: anemia with normal or large red blood cells
low red blood cell count with normal or big cells
scarring and thickening of bone marrow
bone marrow replaced by fibrous tissue

rare.symptomName: Cutaneous manifestations such as petechiae or ecchymoses

searchTerms: lung infections from low white cells
lung infections due to immune deficiency

laboratory: Bone marrow dysplasia and blasts increase
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) in some cases
imaging: Splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT scan
other: Progression from MDS to AML in some patients

distinguishingFeatures: No family history of hematologic malignancy
Later age of onset without inherited predisposition

redFlags: Early onset of myeloid malignancy in multiple family members
Rapid progression from MDS to AML
references: Churpek JE, et al. DDX41 mutations in myeloid neoplasms: clinical and biological features. Blood. 2015.
Lewinsohn M, et al. Germline DDX41 mutations define a unique subtype of myeloid neoplasms. Blood. 2016.
Orphanet: DDX41-related hematologic malignancy predisposition syndrome. ORPHA:488647.
